{"claims":[{"claim_text":"The Democratic Socialists of America affirm and support the goals of #8toAbolition.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The Democratic Socialists of America state they can no longer abide the oppression waged on Black people at the hands of a white supremacist, misogynist, imperialist, and capitalist police state.",
"claim_types":["characterization"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The Democratic Socialists of America state demands for minor reforms have gone unanswered and proven ineffective for far too long.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The Democratic Socialists of America take responsibility for keeping pressure on elected officials, the state and federal government, local municipalities, union allies, organization allies, and everyday people to end police and military injustice, not only in this moment, but for as long as it takes.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Abolition is acknowledged as the path forward.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Through abolition and reparations, resources must be given to communities most deeply impacted by racism and policing.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The country must confront and reconcile its history, materially atoning for the abuses and deaths upon which its empire was built.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The goal is to create a world which values the lives of all Black people, understanding none are free until all are free.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The organization lifts up Black women’s lives, Black trans lives, Black Indigenous lives, Black immigrant lives, and everyone for whom specific and extreme violence awaits at the intersection.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
